Proof in the paper: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) pattern in Fig. S1b can be indexed as a cubic structure (JCPDS 09-234). The lattice fringe with an interplanar spacing of 2.6 Å was assigned to the (210) planes of the cubic CoSe2 nanostructures, indicating the maintained structures of Pd1-CoSe2 nanobelts during the Pd atom anchoring.
